source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The account-settings test resolves identity.smtpServerKey as a menulist whose child is smtpPopup. This patch directs shown/hidden waits to menu.menupopup. The original still clicks menuitems; accepted source later uses activateItem, so popup-target repair and activation repair are distinct phases. Direct assertions check the selected server and edit-button state, but no fresh run or lasting intermittent cure is established.
title: Outgoing-server popup waits target the menulist child popup
